title: Evidence Collector configuration (config.json)
description: Schema for editors (Visual Studio, VS Code) giving validation and auto-complete. The application clamps out-of-range values at start-up and lists every adjustment; a file that cannot be parsed is never overwritten (built-in defaults are used instead). Comments and trailing commas are allowed in config.json.

policy.description: Ignore = not reported; Warn = reported, the phase can still pass; Block = the phase fails until the problem is solved.

theme.description: User-interface theme. The theme button of the application rewrites this value in place.

showAuditPanel.description: Show the live audit-log panel at the bottom of the window.

outputRoot.description: Where session folders are created. %ENV% variables are expanded.

tempRoot.description: Private working folder (browser profile, live network log). Wiped when the session ends.

webViewRuntimeFolder.description: Optional fixed-version WebView2 runtime folder; empty = installed Evergreen runtime.

sessionIdPrefix.description: Prefix of the session identifier (letters and digits, 8 characters at most).

caseReference.description: Default case reference shown in the session form.

requireCaseReference.description: The session form refuses an empty case reference.

requireOperatorName.description: The session form refuses an empty operator name.

enforcePhaseOrder.description: Phase N can only be opened once phase N-1 passed.

hostsFilePolicy.description: Custom entries in the hosts file.

requirePublicIp.description: Phase 2 fails when the public IP address cannot be confirmed.

requireNtpSync.description: Phase 1 / sealing fail when the clock cannot be synchronised.

minimumFreeDiskMb.description: Minimum free disk space on the output drive.

clearLocalStorage.description: Local and session storage, IndexedDB, service workers.

secureWipeTemp.description: Overwrite temporary files before deleting them (best effort; not guaranteed on SSD).

secureWipeMaxFileMb.description: Larger files are deleted without being overwritten.

publicIpEndpoints.description: HTTPS endpoints that return the caller's IP address as plain text.

minimumAgreeingEndpoints.description: How many endpoints must return the same address.

collectRawCommandOutput.description: Record the literal output of ipconfig /all and netsh winhttp show proxy.

proxyTestUrl.description: URL used to resolve the effective system proxy.

vpnInterfaceKeywords.description: Case-insensitive words that identify a VPN adapter.

nonVpnTunnelKeywords.description: Tunnel adapters that are not a VPN (Teredo, ISATAP…).

servers.description: NTP servers queried (several independent sources are compared).

minimumResponses.description: Servers that must answer for the synchronisation to count.

maxAllowedOffsetMs.description: A larger PC-clock error is reported as a warning (the clock is never modified).

inPrivateMode.description: InPrivate profile: nothing is written to disk by the browser.

disableCache.description: Every resource is fetched from the network.

language.description: Browser UI language (BCP-47, e.g. en-US); empty = runtime default.

defaultScheme.description: Scheme added when the operator types a bare host name.

blockPrivateAddresses.description: Refuse navigation to loopback / private network addresses.

allowDownloads.description: Downloads are refused by default (they are not part of the evidence package).

waitForPageCompleteMs.description: How long a capture waits for the page to finish loading.

keepRawImage.description: Also keep the unmodified PNG next to the stamped one.

autoScrollBeforeFullPage.description: Scroll once from top to bottom to trigger lazy-loaded content.

mode.description: Band = strip added outside the page image (hides nothing); Overlay = drawn over the page.

localTimeZoneId.description: Time zone printed next to the UTC time; empty = this PC's zone.

saveRawResponseBody.description: The HTML exactly as received from the server.

storeCookieValues.description: false = only names, attributes, value length and SHA-256 of the value are stored.

enabled.description: Capture automatically each time a page finished loading.

algorithms.description: SHA-256 is always computed; add SHA512 for a second digest.

flushEveryEntry.description: Flush the audit log to disk after every entry (safest).

writeTextLog.description: Also write a human-readable audit.log next to audit.jsonl.
